note: Three loops on the east shore of Greig Lake, next to a cottage subdivision with a store, beach, boat launch and a private 18-hole mini-golf. Loop A's lakeside row (G1-G13) looks across the lake through a fringe of trees a few metres to 25 m from the shore. Six Loop C sites take only an 18-ft unit (G110, G119, G131, G133, G140, G141). Four group camps sit apart from the loops. --Claude
